name: Stewardship Of Gods Creation
overview: Scripture reveals that God created mankind in His image and entrusted them with dominion over all living creatures and the earth itself, calling them to be fruitful, multiply, and subdue the land (Genesis 1:26, 28). This stewardship is further emphasized in Genesis 2:15, where Adam is placed in the Garden of Eden to dress and keep it, highlighting a responsibility to care for God’s creation. The earth and all it contains belong to the Lord (Psalms 24:1), and humans are accountable for how they treat this divine heritage, as seen in Jeremiah 2:7 where defiling the land is condemned. Even the creatures of the earth and sky are portrayed as teachers about God’s wisdom and design (Job 12:7), underscoring the sacred trust given to humanity to manage creation faithfully under God’s authority.
